applied: before Pugh scoring; any gate FAIL excludes the concept from scoring

gates.name: no-fall retention
pass_if_all: positive mechanical interlock pod-to-base (not friction-, adhesive- or magnet-only)
stated load path pod -> base plate -> fixings -> ceiling for drywall, concrete and T-bar
twist-off needs deliberate rotation against a detent; accidental release prevention stated
retention loads per REQ-MECH-015 (safety factor value may be TBD at G2; mechanism may not)

gates.name: enclosure flammability
sources: Q-17 (class set by a qualified human)
pass_if_all: every enclosure part names a material and grade per process
each grade cites a published UL 94 listing at or below its wall thickness, or is marked fit-check only
no dependence on a material with no UL 94 listing

gates.name: radar window material and thickness
pass_if_all: radome er and tan-delta from the MDS s8 table or a cited datasheet (PETG, SLA resin and PA12 need a citation or a measurement plan)
T = N*c/(2*f*sqrt(er)) at f = 60 GHz with integer N, from that er; uniform and smooth over the FoV
antenna-to-radome inner-surface gap d = N*2.5 mm, held by a stated datum
no metal, metallic pigment or conductive coating within the 60 deg half-angle cone
